content: system_message User Input: I want to create a toy car model. Create a box with dimensions 200x100x100(X,Y,Z) as the body. The windshield can be created by subtracting a 50x100x50 block from an upper edge of the box. Add four wheels with a radius of 25 and a thickness of 10: Place two at (25,0,0) and (175,0,0) facing in the Y-Axis (0,1,0), and two at (25,100,0) and (175,100,0) facing in the negative Y-Axis (0,-1,0). | Now i want you to execute the prepared function calls one after the other. If you need to do some calculations or geometrical algebra, use the CreateCode Function first. Execute the first prepared function call. Submit all required variables at once

content.text: I'll start by creating the main body of the toy car, which is a 200x100x100 box.

content.content: successfully created block object. Call now the next function!

content.text: The main body block has been created successfully. Now I'll create the windshield by subtracting a block from the upper edge of the car body.

content: Please call the next Function! If you are finished, call the finished function

content.text: I'll now create the windshield by subtracting a 50x100x50 block from the upper edge of the box. This block needs to be positioned at the front upper edge.

content.content: successfully created block object. Call now the next function!

content.text: The windshield cutout has been created. Now I'll add the first wheel at position (25,0,0).

content: Please call the next Function! If you are finished, call the finished function

content.text: I'll now create the first wheel at position (25,0,0) facing in the Y-axis direction (0,1,0) with radius 25 and thickness 10.

content.content: successfully created cylinder object. Call now the next function!

content.text: The first wheel has been created. Now I'll create the second wheel at position (175,0,0).

content: Please call the next Function! If you are finished, call the finished function

content.text: I'll now create the second wheel at position (175,0,0) facing in the Y-axis direction (0,1,0) with radius 25 and thickness 10.

content.content: successfully created cylinder object. Call now the next function!

content.text: The second wheel has been created. Now I'll create the third wheel at position (25,100,0) facing in the negative Y-axis direction.

content: Please call the next Function! If you are finished, call the finished function

content.text: I'll now create the third wheel at position (25,100,0) facing in the negative Y-axis direction (0,-1,0) with radius 25 and thickness 10. Since the wheel faces in the negative Y direction, I need to start from Y=100 and extend -10 in the Y direction.

content.content: successfully created cylinder object. Call now the next function!

content.text: The third wheel has been created. Now I'll create the fourth and final wheel at position (175,100,0).

content: Please call the next Function! If you are finished, call the finished function

content.text: I'll now create the fourth and final wheel at position (175,100,0) facing in the negative Y-axis direction (0,-1,0) with radius 25 and thickness 10.

content.content: successfully created cylinder object. Call now the next function!

content.text: All components of the toy car have been created successfully. Now I'll call the finished function.
